answers.answer: 要旨は250語以内です。要旨に文献引用は入れません。
answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.

answers.answer: 文字数は50文字以内（スペース含む）。ページ3の奇数ページからヘッダーに必要です。
answers.basis: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required.

answers.answer: 文献番号は角括弧で囲み、句点やコンマの前に置く。例: [1,3,5-8].
answers.basis: References should be numbered sequentially... When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の6著者を列挙し、続けて “et al.” と記載します。
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”

answers.answer: 図はTIFF, PNG, JPEG, PDF形式で300dpi以上。グラフィカルアブストラクトはPNG, JPEG, GIF形式で300dpi。
answers.basis: Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi... We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats. ... The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: 1) 表は本文中で必ず引用する。2) アラビア数字で連番付けし、上部に短いタイトルを付ける。3) 縦線は使用せず、脚注は a, b, c… の文字で付す。
answers.basis: All tables must be cited in the text... Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals... Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table... Do not use vertical lines.

answers.answer: 各ファイルは20 MB以下です。超える場合はJ‑STAGE Data等のリポジトリにアップロードし、編集部に連絡します。
answers.basis: The size of each file ... should be no more than 20 MB. When the supplementary materials are larger than 20 MB, please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J‑STAGE Data... In this case, please contact the Editorial office.

answers.answer: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented” などの肯定的表現は使用できません。
answers.basis: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words.

answers.answer: 編集判断受領後90日以内です。
answers.basis: Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
